per_record_results.context: In my role as a dermatologist with 4 years of experience, I recently took on a project that involved developing a comprehensive treatment plan for a patient with a severe case of eczema. The patient, a 25-year-old woman named Sarah, had been struggling with the condition for several years and had tried various treatments with limited success. I started by conducting a thorough examination of Sarah's skin, taking note of the extent and severity of her eczema. I also asked her about her medical history, lifestyle, and any potential triggers that could be exacerbating her condition. Based on my findings, I diagnosed Sarah with atopic dermatitis, a type of eczema that is often associated with allergies and asthma. To address Sarah's eczema, I created a tailored treatment plan that included a combination of topical medications, lifestyle modifications, and stress management techniques. I prescribed a topical corticosteroid cream to help reduce inflammation and itching, as well as an emollient cream to keep her skin moisturized. I also recommended that Sarah make changes to her diet, such as avoiding foods that are known to trigger eczema flare-ups. Additionally, I suggested that she incorporate stress-relieving activities, such as yoga or meditation, into her routine. To ensure that Sarah was adhering to her treatment plan and making progress, I scheduled regular follow-up appointments. During these visits, I assessed her skin's condition and made adjustments to her treatment regimen as needed. I also provided her with ongoing support and guidance, answering her questions and addressing any concerns she had. Over time, Sarah's eczema symptoms gradually improved. The redness and itching subsided, and her skin became smoother and less inflamed. She expressed immense gratitude for the positive results she was experiencing and thanked me for my expertise and care. I am proud to have played a role in helping Sarah manage her eczema and improve her quality of life. This project not only allowed me to utilize my skills and knowledge as a dermatologist but also reinforced my commitment to providing compassionate and effective care to my patients. (Contact information and personal details have been omitted for privacy reasons.)

per_record_results.context: As a professor with 19 years of experience, I've had the opportunity to work on numerous projects that have made a significant impact on my career. One project that particularly stands out is my research on "The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Enhancing Educational Outcomes." This project was conducted during my tenure as a faculty member at the University of California, Berkeley. The project aimed to explore how AI technologies could be leveraged to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of teaching and learning. To initiate the project, I assembled a team of researchers, including experts in AI, education, and psychology. Together, we conducted an extensive literature review to gain a comprehensive understanding of the current state of AI in education. We also conducted interviews with educators and students to gather insights into their experiences and challenges. Based on our findings, we developed a conceptual framework that outlined the potential applications of AI in education. This framework served as the foundation for the design of our research experiments. We conducted a series of controlled experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of different AI-based interventions on student learning outcomes. Our results demonstrated that AI could significantly improve student engagement, knowledge acquisition, and critical thinking skills. The findings of our research have been widely disseminated through publications in top academic journals, presentations at international conferences, and collaborations with educational institutions around the world. This project has not only contributed to the advancement of knowledge in the field of AI in education but has also had a direct impact on improving the quality of education for students at all levels. In addition to my research work, I am an active member of the academic community. I have served on the editorial boards of several prestigious journals and have been invited to give keynote speeches at conferences worldwide. I am also a strong advocate for using technology to enhance teaching and learning. My webpage https://yzhu.biz provides resources and insights on the latest advancements in educational technology. For those interested in collaborating on research projects or seeking consulting services, they can reach me through my Upwork profile, y.zhu. My dedication to education extends beyond my academic pursuits. As a passionate educator, I strive to create a supportive and engaging learning environment for my students. I am committed to helping them develop the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in their chosen fields and become responsible and compassionate members of society. I am grateful for the opportunities I have had throughout my career to make a positive impact on the lives of my students and colleagues. I look forward to continuing my work in education and contributing to the development of innovative and effective approaches to teaching and learning.

per_record_results.context: As a seasoned psychiatrist with 16 years of experience, I find immense fulfillment in helping individuals navigate the intricacies of their mental health. Recently, I embarked on a project that left a profound impact on me and reinforced my belief in the transformative power of psychotherapy. One day, a young woman named Sarah, a patient of mine, came to my office with an air of desperation. She had been struggling with severe anxiety and depression for several years, and despite trying various medications and therapies, she felt like she was barely surviving. Determined to help Sarah find lasting relief, I decided to employ a holistic approach that addressed both her psychological and emotional well-being. I reached out to my colleagues in other disciplines, including a nutritionist and a mindfulness instructor. Together, we created a comprehensive treatment plan that focused on improving Sarah's overall health and well-being. I guided Sarah through intensive psychotherapy sessions, helping her to identify the root causes of her anxiety and depression. We worked on developing coping mechanisms, such as relaxation techniques and cognitive-behavioral strategies, to manage her symptoms. In addition to psychotherapy, I encouraged Sarah to make positive changes to her lifestyle. With the help of the nutritionist, she adopted a healthier diet and began regular exercise, which helped improve her energy levels and overall mood. The mindfulness instructor taught her meditation and deep breathing exercises, which proved instrumental in reducing her stress and anxiety. Over time, Sarah's progress was remarkable. She began to experience fewer episodes of anxiety and depression, and her overall outlook on life improved significantly. She was able to return to work and pursue her hobbies, things that had once seemed impossible. I am humbled and grateful to have been a part of Sarah's journey toward recovery. Her resilience and determination inspired me, and the positive outcome of her treatment reaffirmed my commitment to providing compassionate and evidence-based care to my patients. If you would like to learn more about my work, you can visit my webpage at https://www.zpeters.edu or connect with me on Facebook at zaynpeters. You can also reach me at my office address, 262 Joseph Prairie.

My initial step was to gather data and analyze the existing process. Through this process, I discovered that the manual paperwork and multiple handoffs were causing significant delays and frustration for customers. To address these challenges, I spearheaded the implementation of an online loan application system. This system allowed customers to apply for loans securely and conveniently from the comfort of their own homes. The system also included automated workflows that routed applications to the appropriate loan officers, eliminating the need for manual handoffs and reducing processing time. To ensure a seamless transition to the new system, I developed a comprehensive training program for loan officers and customer service representatives. The training covered the features and functionalities of the online system, as well as best practices for providing excellent customer service. The implementation of the online loan application system proved to be a resounding success. Within six months, the average loan processing time was reduced by 30%, resulting in improved customer satisfaction and increased loan approvals. The system also led to cost savings for the bank by reducing the need for paperwork and manual labor. Through this project, I was able to demonstrate my leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills. I am proud of the positive impact it had on the bank's operations and the overall customer experience. per_record_results.context: During my tenure as an orthopedist with four years of expertise, I encountered a compelling case that tested my abilities and led to a significant breakthrough in patient care. It all started when a young athlete, let's call him Alex, came to my clinic with a severe knee injury he sustained during a soccer match. Alex was devastated, fearing his athletic career might be over. Determined to help him regain his mobility and athletic prowess, I delved into a comprehensive treatment plan. To begin, I conducted a thorough examination of Alex's knee, using advanced imaging techniques to assess the extent of the damage. The MRI revealed a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), a common injury among athletes. I explained the situation to Alex and outlined the various treatment options available, including surgical intervention and physical therapy. Given Alex's age and active lifestyle, we opted for surgical repair of the ACL. I performed the surgery meticulously, using minimally invasive techniques to minimize scarring and expedite recovery. Post-surgery, I closely monitored Alex's progress, providing him with personalized rehabilitation exercises and pain management strategies. I also encouraged him to maintain a positive mindset and focus on his long-term goals. As Alex progressed through his rehabilitation, I was impressed by his dedication and resilience. He followed my instructions diligently, attending every physical therapy session and adhering to the prescribed exercises. His unwavering determination inspired me to go the extra mile and develop a tailored training regimen that would help him regain his athletic abilities. To my delight, Alex made a remarkable recovery. Not only did he regain full mobility in his knee, but he also surpassed his pre-injury athletic performance. He returned to soccer with renewed vigor, showcasing exceptional speed and agility. Seeing Alex back on the field, playing the sport he loves, was an incredibly fulfilling moment for me as a physician. Throughout this journey, I remained accessible to Alex, answering his questions and providing guidance whenever he needed it. I believe in fostering a strong patient-physician relationship built on trust and open communication. This approach not only enhances the quality of care but also accelerates the healing process. If you are interested in learning more about my approach to orthopedics and patient care, I invite you to visit my webpage at http://blog.ishimizu.net.asp. You can also connect with me on Instagram @ishimizu, where I share insights into the latest advancements in orthopedics and provide tips for maintaining joint health. My address is 9593 Hudson Islands Apt. 223, so feel free to reach out if you have any inquiries or would like to schedule an appointment. It would be my honor to assist you on your journey to optimal joint health and mobility.

per_record_results.context: During my tenure as an anesthesiologist with one year of experience, I embarked on a project that profoundly impacted my professional growth and solidified my commitment to patient-centered care. This project involved implementing a comprehensive pain management protocol for orthopedic patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty, a procedure commonly known as knee replacement surgery. I recognized the significant pain challenges faced by patients undergoing this surgery and sought to optimize their pain control through a multimodal approach. I collaborated with a team of dedicated healthcare professionals, including surgeons, nurses, and physical therapists, to develop a standardized protocol that would guide pain management throughout the perioperative period. The protocol encompassed various pain management strategies, including: - Preemptive analgesia: Administering pain medication before the onset of pain to mitigate the severity and duration of postoperative pain. - Patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) pumps: Providing patients with devices that allowed them to self-administer pain medication, ensuring continuous and effective pain relief. - Multimodal analgesia: Utilizing a combination of different pain medications with different mechanisms of action to enhance pain relief and minimize side effects. - Early mobilization: Encouraging patients to engage in physical therapy exercises as soon as possible after surgery to promote recovery and reduce pain. - Comprehensive patient education: Providing detailed information to patients about their pain management plan, potential side effects, and the importance of adherence to the protocol. To ensure the successful implementation of the protocol, I conducted thorough research, reviewed relevant literature, and consulted with experts in the field. I also organized educational sessions for healthcare providers involved in the care of orthopedic patients, emphasizing the importance of effective pain management and the protocol's specific guidelines. The implementation of the comprehensive pain management protocol resulted in several positive outcomes. Postoperative pain scores decreased significantly, and patient satisfaction with pain control improved remarkably. Additionally, the incidence of complications associated with inadequate pain management, such as prolonged hospital stays and the need for additional interventions, was markedly reduced. The success of this project reinforced my belief in the power of collaboration and evidence-based practice in improving patient care. It also highlighted the crucial role of anesthesiologists in optimizing pain management and enhancing the overall surgical experience for orthopedic patients. Visit my webpage at www.shenbecker.org/profile.asp or connect with me on LinkedIn at shenbecker to learn more about my professional journey and contributions to the field of anesthesiology.

per_record_results.context: I'm Badi da Silva, a plumber with over 10 years of experience in the field. I've encountered countless plumbing issues throughout my career, but one that stands out vividly is a particularly challenging clogged drain situation at a local restaurant. I received a call from the restaurant manager, who desperately needed help with a persistent clog in their kitchen sink. When I arrived at the establishment, I was greeted with the unpleasant sight of overflowing water and foul odors emanating from the sink. Upon examining the sink, I noticed that the clog was caused by a buildup of grease, food scraps, and other debris that had accumulated over time. The blockage was so severe that it prevented any water from draining properly. Without hesitation, I donned my protective gear and prepared to tackle the clog head-on. Using a specialized drain snake, I carefully inserted it into the drainpipe, maneuvering it through the twists and turns until I reached the source of the blockage. With a combination of patience and persistence, I worked diligently to break down the clog and remove the debris. The process was not without its challenges, as the clog was stubborn and required considerable effort to dislodge. After what felt like an eternity, I finally managed to clear the blockage completely. The water began to drain freely, much to the relief of the restaurant staff. As I packed up my tools, the manager approached me with a heartfelt thank-you. He expressed his gratitude for my prompt response, professionalism, and the exceptional service I had provided. I left the restaurant feeling a sense of accomplishment, knowing that I had not only solved their plumbing problem but had also made a positive impact on their business. If you're experiencing plumbing issues, don't hesitate to reach out to me at badidasilva@yahoo.gov or visit me at 225 Almond Street. I'm always ready to lend a helping hand and provide expert solutions to all your plumbing needs.

per_record_results.context: In my role as a saleswoman, I have encountered various challenges, but one that stands out is the time I resolved a customer's issue with a defective product. My name is Mary Hernandez, and you can reach me at mary.hernandez@outlook.net or find me at 2849 Quail Drive. One day, a customer named Mr. Smith approached me with a complaint about a faulty laptop he had purchased from our store. The device kept crashing, and no matter how many times he rebooted it, the problem persisted. After listening attentively to his concerns, I immediately empathized with his frustration and assured him that I would do everything in my power to rectify the situation. To thoroughly investigate the issue, I requested that Mr. Smith bring the laptop back to the store so that our tech team could conduct a comprehensive diagnosis. While we awaited the results, I kept in constant communication with Mr. Smith, providing regular updates and assuring him that we were actively working on finding a solution. Upon receiving the laptop, our tech team discovered a hardware defect that was causing the persistent crashes. Without hesitation, we initiated the process of replacing the faulty component, ensuring that Mr. Smith would have a fully functional laptop as soon as possible. While waiting for the replacement part to arrive, I arranged for Mr. Smith to borrow a temporary laptop so that he could continue his work without disruption. I also offered him a discount on his next purchase as a token of our sincere apology for the inconvenience he had experienced. Once the replacement part arrived, our tech team swiftly installed it, and I personally tested the laptop to ensure that it was functioning flawlessly. I then contacted Mr. Smith to inform him that his laptop was ready for collection. Upon arriving at the store, Mr. Smith expressed his heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional service he had received. He commended me for my proactive approach, empathy, and unwavering commitment to resolving his issue. Witnessing the satisfaction on his face made all the effort worthwhile. Through this experience, I reaffirmed the importance of customer-centricity in sales. By actively listening, empathizing, communicating effectively, and taking prompt action, I was able to transform a challenging situation into a positive and memorable customer experience.

per_record_results.context: As Sergey Wagner, a saleswoman dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, I recently encountered a challenging situation that required my creativity and problem-solving skills. It all started when a customer, Mrs. Roberts, came to our store expressing her disappointment with a product she had purchased a week earlier. The product, a high-end kitchen appliance, had malfunctioned, causing significant inconvenience to Mrs. Roberts and her family. Upon hearing Mrs. Roberts's concerns, I immediately empathized with her frustration and took ownership of the situation. I listened attentively to her detailed explanation of the problem, asking probing questions to fully understand the issue at hand. My goal was to not only resolve the immediate problem but also to prevent similar issues from arising in the future. After gathering all the necessary information, I conducted a thorough investigation, examining the product and consulting with our technical support team. I discovered that the malfunction was caused by a faulty component, which needed to be replaced. However, the specific component was not readily available in our store, and ordering it from the manufacturer would take several days, leaving Mrs. Roberts without a functional appliance in the meantime. Determined to find a solution that would minimize the inconvenience to Mrs. Roberts, I reached out to my network of suppliers and partners. Through diligent research and negotiation, I was able to locate a nearby store that had the required component in stock. I immediately arranged for the part to be delivered to our store, ensuring that it would arrive the next morning. Upon receiving the replacement component, I personally oversaw the repair process, ensuring that it was carried out promptly and correctly. Once the repair was complete, I thoroughly tested the appliance to ensure it was fully functional and met Mrs. Roberts's expectations. To my relief and delight, Mrs. Roberts was thrilled with the outcome. She expressed her gratitude for my commitment to resolving the issue swiftly and effectively. The successful resolution of this situation reinforced my belief in the importance of customer-centric service and the power of collaboration in achieving positive outcomes. Looking back on this experience, I am proud of the way I handled the situation. My dedication to providing exceptional customer service, combined with my problem-solving skills and resourcefulness, enabled me to find a solution that exceeded Mrs. Roberts's expectations. In addition to my commitment to customer satisfaction, I am also passionate about staying up-to-date on the latest industry trends and developments. I regularly attend training sessions and workshops to enhance my knowledge and expertise. I believe that continuous learning is essential for providing the best possible service to my customers. Contact Information: Sergey Wagner 1076 Foster Street Email: sergey-wagner@msn.edu

per_record_results.context: As Officer Tatiana Ito, I'm known for my diligence and sharp instincts, honed over the past seven years in the police force. My journey has been marked by various impactful projects, one of which stands out vividly in my memory. It was a sweltering summer day when a call came in about a series of suspicious activities at the local community center. Several valuable items had gone missing, and residents were on edge. I was assigned to investigate the case. With unwavering determination, I delved into the investigation, meticulously gathering evidence and conducting interviews. I spent countless hours studying security footage, searching for clues that could lead to the perpetrator. My perseverance paid off when I noticed a peculiar pattern in the footage—a figure clad in a black hoodie and sunglasses kept appearing at the center shortly before the thefts. Armed with this vital clue, I intensified my efforts, checking local pawn shops and interviewing anyone who might have information. The trail eventually led me to a rundown apartment where I discovered the stolen items hidden away in a closet. In a dramatic confrontation, I apprehended the suspect, a petty thief with a history of larceny. The stolen goods were returned to their rightful owners, and the community breathed a collective sigh of relief. I felt a surge of satisfaction, knowing that my hard work had made a real difference in the lives of the people I served. My dedication to my job doesn't end at the station; I'm also actively involved in community initiatives. In my spare time, I pursue my hobby of soap making, crafting unique and fragrant bars of soap that I share with friends and family. I find that the creative process is a refreshing contrast to the rigors of my profession. I'm always willing to lend a helping hand, whether it's volunteering at local events or mentoring young people who aspire to a career in law enforcement. My contact details are (44) 93739-7380 and tatianaito4161@gmail.org. Living at 950 Crystal Fords, I'm proud to be a part of this vibrant community. I'm committed to serving and protecting its residents, ensuring their safety and well-being. Each day brings new challenges and opportunities, and I'm grateful for the chance to make a positive impact in the lives of those I encounter.

per_record_results.context: One of the most memorable projects I worked on as a chef with three years of experience was the planning and execution of a five-course fine dining tasting menu at a prestigious culinary event. The theme of the menu was "Culinary Journey Through Asia," and I was tasked with creating a unique and unforgettable dining experience that showcased the diverse flavors and techniques of Asian cuisine.  To start, I visited various Asian markets and local farms to handpick the freshest and most authentic ingredients. From vibrant spices to exotic vegetables, I carefully curated a selection of items that would bring my culinary vision to life.  Next, I spent countless hours experimenting and refining my recipes, ensuring that each dish was not only visually stunning but also packed with flavor. From delicate steamed dumplings infused with ginger and lemongrass to a tender braised pork belly glazed with a sweet and tangy hoisin sauce, each course was carefully crafted to delight the palate.  On the day of the event, I led a team of skilled chefs in the kitchen, ensuring that every dish was prepared with meticulous attention to detail. The kitchen buzzed with excitement as we coordinated the timing and presentation of each course, working seamlessly to create a cohesive and memorable dining experience.  As the guests arrived, I had the pleasure of introducing each dish personally, explaining the inspiration behind its creation and the unique flavors they were about to encounter. The feedback from the guests was overwhelmingly positive, with many praising the intricate flavors, beautiful presentation, and overall ambiance of the evening.  To share my culinary journey with a broader audience, I documented the entire process, from the ingredient sourcing to the final plating, and shared it on my website (bsuzuki.edu) and Twitter profile (@barbara.suzuki). The response from the online community was incredible, with many expressing their admiration for my creativity and passion for Asian cuisine. This project not only allowed me to showcase my skills and knowledge as a chef but also reinforced my belief in the power of food to bring people together and create unforgettable experiences. It remains one of the most rewarding and cherished projects of my culinary career.

Next, I assembled a dynamic team of skilled programmers, each bringing their unique expertise to the table. We collaborated seamlessly, leveraging our collective knowledge and diverse skill sets to design and develop a state-of-the-art data management system. Throughout the project, I remained committed to maintaining open lines of communication with stakeholders, ensuring that their feedback was incorporated into every iteration of the system. I hosted regular progress meetings, meticulously documented project milestones, and promptly addressed any concerns or queries that arose. This transparent and collaborative approach fostered a sense of ownership among stakeholders and ensured that the final product aligned perfectly with their expectations. As the project neared completion, I conducted rigorous testing and quality assurance procedures to ensure that the new system met the highest standards of performance and reliability. I worked tirelessly to identify and rectify any bugs or glitches, paying meticulous attention to detail and leaving no stone unturned. My unwavering commitment to delivering a flawless product paid off when the system was finally deployed and received overwhelmingly positive feedback from users across the organization. The project's resounding success not only earned me recognition and appreciation from my superiors but also reinforced my belief in the transformative power of innovative technology. per_record_results.context: As a seasoned extreme sport professional with nine years of experience, I've had the privilege of embarking on numerous exhilarating projects. One such project that stands out was the development of a groundbreaking training program for aspiring BMX riders. My journey began when I received a call from the Xtreme Sports Academy, a renowned institution dedicated to nurturing talent in extreme sports. They had heard about my expertise in BMX riding and wanted me to design and implement a comprehensive training program for their aspiring athletes. With great enthusiasm, I accepted the challenge. I started by conducting thorough research on the latest techniques, training methods, and safety protocols in BMX riding. I spent countless hours analyzing videos, interviewing top riders, and attending workshops to gain a deep understanding of the sport. To ensure the program's effectiveness, I incorporated a holistic approach that encompassed physical conditioning, mental training, and technical skill development. I collaborated with a team of experts, including nutritionists, sports psychologists, and experienced BMX coaches, to create a well-rounded curriculum that addressed all aspects of the sport. The program was meticulously structured, starting with basic skills and gradually progressing to advanced maneuvers. I emphasized the importance of safety, ensuring that each rider had the proper protective gear and understood the risks involved. To keep the riders engaged and motivated, I incorporated a variety of training methods, including drills, obstacle courses, and simulated competitions. I also organized regular field trips to renowned BMX parks and trails, providing the riders with opportunities to experience different terrains and riding conditions. My dedication to this project was unwavering. I spent countless hours mentoring the riders, providing personalized feedback, and pushing them to reach their full potential. The program quickly gained popularity, attracting riders from across the country. The success of the program was evident in the remarkable progress made by the riders. They not only improved their skills and confidence but also developed a strong sense of camaraderie and sportsmanship. Many of them went on to compete in regional and national BMX competitions, achieving impressive results. I am immensely proud of the impact this project has had on the lives of these young athletes. It is incredibly rewarding to see them grow as riders and as individuals, pursuing their passion for BMX with renewed vigor and determination. As I reflect on this project, I am reminded of the importance of passion, dedication, and collaboration in achieving great things. It is through these qualities that I have been able to make a positive difference in the lives of aspiring BMX riders.

The success of this project is a testament to the dedication and hard work of our entire team. With nimble fingers and a keen eye for detail, Abdul had spent years honing his skills, transforming precious metals and gemstones into exquisite pieces of art. One day, a distinguished gentleman named Mr. Smith approached Abdul's jewelry store. Mr. Smith had a vision for a unique engagement ring that would symbolize his enduring love and commitment to his beloved. He shared his ideas with Abdul, describing the intricate design he had in mind. Abdul was immediately captivated by the challenge and saw it as an opportunity to showcase his artistry. Abdul began by sketching out various concepts, meticulously considering each element of the ring. He carefully selected the finest diamonds, ensuring they were of exceptional clarity and brilliance. With the design finalized, Abdul embarked on the intricate process of crafting the ring. He spent countless hours in his workshop, meticulously shaping and molding the metal, setting the diamonds with precision, and polishing the ring to a flawless finish. As he worked, Abdul drew inspiration from the love story that the ring would symbolize. He imagined the joy and happiness it would bring to the couple who would soon wear it. The ring became a testament to his dedication to his craft and his passion for creating objects of beauty and significance. Finally, the day arrived when the ring was complete. Abdul carefully placed it in a velvet box, admiring the way the diamonds sparkled and caught the light. He couldn't wait to see the look of joy on Mr. Smith's face when he presented him with the finished masterpiece. Mr. Smith was overwhelmed with emotion when he saw the ring. He thanked Abdul profusely, praising his exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail. The ring was everything he had hoped for and more. He knew that it would be a cherished heirloom, passed down through generations to come. As Abdul watched Mr. Smith leave the store, a sense of pride and fulfillment washed over him. He knew that he had created something truly special, something that would bring joy and happiness to others. It was moments like these that made him realize that he had found his true calling in life as a jeweler.

metric_definitions.cases_with_leakage_pct: Percentage of evaluated cases where at least one ground-truth PII entity remained exposed.
metric_definitions.utility_score: Normalized composite score [0.000-1.000] combining non-PII token retention (55%), token Jaccard similarity (30%), and structural/query fluency (15%).
metric_definitions.context_accuracy: Percentage of cases where the method satisfied ground-truth contextual privacy norms (ALLOW/DENY decision match or safe sensitive PII protection).
metric_definitions.unsafe_allow_rate: Percentage of DENY cases where sensitive PII was improperly exposed to untrusted recipients.
